# `.github/`

**What it is.** Configuration read by GitHub-side and Copilot-style assistants.

**Purpose in the repository.** Holds `copilot-instructions.md`, a placeholder memory file for an assistant plug-in. It carries no project rules: the binding rules are in `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root.

**Files directly in this folder:** 1 (besides this README).  
Repository-wide status of every file: [`LEGACY_MAP.md`](../LEGACY_MAP.md).
